rows.title: Inside Sales Appointment Coordinator
rows.text: Inside Sales Appointment Coordinator About Us Semper Solaris is the fastest-growing leader in Residential Solar Installation, also offering Battery Storage, Roofing, and HVAC services. Veteran-owned and proudly operated, our dedication to excellence has earned us an industry-wide reputation as one of the top residential construction and remodeling companies in California. We’re on a mission to help homeowners embrace renewable energy, improve their homes, and create a cleaner future. There’s no better time to join a company that’s growing rapidly and leading the way in sustainable energy solutions. Position Summary We are seeking driven and competitive Inside Sales Appointment Coordinators to join our energetic team. In this role, you will connect with prospects from our existing customer database, re-engage past no-sale appointments, and schedule consultations for solar, roofing, HVAC, and battery services. That means no cold calling —you’ll be working with customers who have already expressed interest and are highly likely to convert. The ideal candidate thrives in sales, enjoys engaging conversations, and is motivated by unlimited earning potential with a clear path for career growth. Why This Role is Different Most sales jobs start you at square one—cold calling and chasing uninterested leads. Not here. At Semper Solaris, you’ll: Work exclusively with pre-qualified leads from our existing customer database Re-engage homeowners who have already shown interest in solar and home upgrades Enjoy no cold calling —just meaningful conversations with customers ready to talk Earn uncapped commissions, bonuses, and cash spiffs on top of hourly pay Grow your career with a veteran-owned company that’s expanding across California This is a sales role designed to set you up for success from day one. Employee Benefits We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including: Competitive hourly rate uncapped commissions Bonus opportunities and cash spiffs Full benefits package: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Voluntary Life & AD&D Life Insurance, HSA , and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Paid sick time and vacation time Career path opportunities for top performers In-office work required for collaboration, training, and team building Responsibilities Engage with prospects from our existing database of interested customers and prior no-sale appointments Reconnect with homeowners to rebuild trust, highlight value, and reschedule consultations Provide information about solar, battery, roofing, HVAC, and other home improvements Build rapport with customers and analyze their needs to recommend the right solutions Answer inbound calls, return missed calls/voicemails, and promptly respond to all inquiries Use data mining and lead qualification techniques to maximize appointment conversion Accurately enter and track lead details in Excel and Salesforce Confirm and record all lead sources (web, radio, referrals, etc.) Perform administrative tasks and support management as needed No cold calling – only engaged, pre-qualified opportunities! Qualifications High school diploma or GED required Inside sales experience preferred; solar/roofing/HVAC sales experience a plus Knowledge of renewable energy is helpful; passion for sustainability is a plus Microsoft Office skills: Excel – organize, format, and calculate data with formulas Outlook – compose, send, and manage emails Word – create and edit documents Salesforce experience a plus Excellent phone communication and lead qualification skills Ability to learn and adapt to new software and processes quickly Strong data entry accuracy and speed Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus Possession of or ability to obtain HIS License required (for sales advancement) Strong hunger for success, competitive spirit, and team player attitude Schedule: Monday – Saturday, 8:00am – 4:30pm (PST) & Sundays, 9:00am – 6:00pm (PST) Pay: $25–$27 per hour PLUS uncapped commissions, bonus potential, and cash spiffs! Semper Solaris is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

rows.text: Join the clean energy revolution! Solar Alternatives, the Louisiana's leading renewable energy company, is seeking an experienced sales consultant and one-call closer for remote, in-home and in-business sales for North Louisiana regional market. Target clients are nearby residential and commercial prospects in Mississippi. Excellent earning potential of $100k-$160k annually. As an Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Companies and winner of the 2018 and 2022 LifeCity Employee Wellness Award, Solar Alternatives' mission is to strengthen communities through comprehensive energy savings, backup power, and a low-carbon lifestyle. Over 4000 families and businesses have worked with our team to realize over $300 million in lifetime savings. If you are a professional who is passionate about helping clients, has successful experience with in-home sales, and can effectively cultivate a robust pipeline with integrity, excellent customer service, and ambitious sales targets, this opportunity is for you. This position is a result of new management plan to accelerate growth and focus on achieving regional market leadership. Thrive with confidence and pride in your work as you develop a strong portfolio of happy clients! Working alongside a skilled support staff with proprietary tools, complete training and ongoing learning opportunities will be provided. This position is primarily home office based, and will focus on local in-person appointments, and remote statewide appointments commercial and residential solar energy prospects. Please review qualifications before applying. RESPONSIBILITIES In-home, in-business and virtual sales of residential solar, energy savings and backup power solutions Additional commercial sales opportunities Generate custom proposals and organize documents necessary for presentation and closing Generate new leads from networking, database, event participation, and relationships Close deals and sign contracts with home and business owners Ability to efficiently plan schedule, set goals and work unsupervised Use company-provided screening procedures to qualify prospects Pursue individual and team sales targets Attend meetings, marketing events and training programs to stay informed of technology trends File sales reports and provide market feedback to team leader Strong potential for advancement Requirements Positive, energetic attitude, and ambitious with a strong desire to succeed Ability to speak with charisma and confidence Self-motivated and disciplined Proven and documented track record of sales success Proficiency in business software - Microsoft Office Suite, Drobbox, Slack Proficiency in standard internet tools and etiquette - email, cloud services, search Articulate and professional English writing and speech, bilingual a plus Willing and able to initiate marketing and self-generate a portion of prospects Reliable transportation, valid license, clean driving record Willing to work occasional weekends as needed for marketing events Experience with CRM, Salesforce.com preferred Home improvement, auto sales or in-home sales experience preferred Benefits Advanced product and sales training to ensure success Unlimited earning potential, with average commission of $2500 per sale Top performers earn $150k per year 100% Commission and Quarterly Bonuses available Two weeks paid leave, plus 7 bank holidays Use of proprietary company tools including industry leading quotation and formatted selling systems Qualified leads from the best sources available The peace of mind that comes with offering only best in class products, installation, and services Gas card & vehicle allowance Health insurance, vision, dental 401K with company match

rows.title: Residential Roofing Sales Representative (Outside Sales)
rows.text: Job Title: Residential Roofing Sales Representative (Outside Sales) Start Date: Immediately Salary Range: $80,000-$180,000 Position Overview: JR&CO is seeking a motivated Residential Roofing Sales Representative (Outside Sales) to generate new business, perform roof inspections, and guide homeowners through the roofing sales process from inspection to project completion. This outside sales representative role combines sales, customer service, and project coordination while giving you the flexibility to manage your own schedule. You will identify opportunities, present roofing solutions, and work with estimators and operations to deliver high-quality projects. This position starts in residential roofing sales with opportunities to expand into service and commercial markets. Join our team and enjoy uncapped earning potential, a supportive culture, and career growth opportunities. At J.R. & Co., Inc., we're not just building roofs—we're building careers. Established in 1986 and proudly veteran-owned, we're an energetic, optimistic, and family-oriented construction company. While roofing is our specialty, our services span everything from sheet metal and solar panel installation to rooftop maintenance and disaster relief. With a reputation for excellence in workmanship and customer service, we’ve earned recognition from top industry manufacturers and an A rating from the BBB. If you're looking for a place to grow, thrive, and make a real impact while working in a safety-focused, supportive environment, J.R. & Co., Inc. is the place for you. Join our team today and help us build something great! Essential Functions: Generate new business through door-to-door sales, referrals, networking, and prospecting Educate homeowners on roof replacement, repair options, and insurance restoration processes Collaborate with estimators and operations to ensure accurate project scope and pricing Track leads, proposals, and sales activity using CRM software Maintain strong customer relationships to generate repeat business and referrals Negotiate contracts and guide customers through the roofing sales process from lead to close Create and present roofing sales proposals and project estimates Perform roof inspections and property assessments for residential customers Required Skills and Abilities: Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally for outside sales appointments Strong communication and presentation skills when working with homeowners Self-motivated with strong time management and ability to work independently Experience with CRM and business software (Microsoft Office; EDGE and Pipedrive preferred) Knowledge of roofing systems, construction processes, or storm restoration is a plus Comfortable working in a fast-paced, commission-driven sales environment Ability to prospect, generate leads, and close residential sales opportunities Experience in roofing sales, construction sales, home improvement sales, or outside sales preferred Education and Experience: 1-3 years B2C or B2B sales experience preferred Knowledge of roofing systems, applications and benefits preferred Construction or contracting background preferred Canvassing sales experience preferred Training, Support, and Development Paid 4 Weeks of training including roofing industry, construction education, and sales training. Access to Company apparel, marketing materials and CRM Fully equipped office and support staff (Administration, production, quality control, etc.) Ongoing paid professional development for new products, and sales training. Work Environment/Physical Requirements: Pass initial drug test and participate in random drug test program Indoor office environment and outdoor door-to-door sales calling Local travel to engage with clients Ability to work evenings and weekends to meet client availability Compensation & Benefits Package: Weekly pay plus u ncapped commissions Company truck or mileage reimbursement Strong bonus and incentive program Health, Dental, vision, life insurance Paid time off 401K with company match Paid Parental Leave Work Location: In person, Colorado Springs, CO and surrounding region. J.R. & Co., Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. JR & Co. Inc. participates in E-Verify. To learn more visit www.e-verify.gov . All individuals who accept an offer of employment are required to complete a pre-employment drug screening and background check.

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Ever since we started in 2007, Sunrun has been at the forefront of connecting people to the cleanest energy on Earth. It’s why we’ve become the 1 home solar and battery company in America. Today, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. And we’re doing it by designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. We’re unlike any other solar company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with. Join the Sunrun Street Team – Where Hustle Meets High Earnings Looking for a role where your drive, grit, and ambition translate directly into income? Whether you're a seasoned closer or new to sales and ready to learn, Sunrun gives you the tools, training, and opportunity to succeed. With uncapped commission, flexible schedules, and world-class support, our Sales Specialists are helping homeowners save money and switch to clean energy, while building incredible careers. 2024 Highlights 50% of our first year Sales Specialists earned $100,000 Top 10% average earnings for new hires was $205,020 Top 100 earners regardless of hire date or current status earned $388,000 Direct seller, commission only role, best suited for highly motivated individuals who thrive on performance-based rewards. How You Will Be Rewarded: Unlimited earnings potential: Top 10% of Sales Specialists earn $300,000 Flexible schedule: Enjoy autonomy of a flexible schedule after the training period World-class training: Learn from the best sales specialists in the industry Career growth: Clear paths for advancement Bonus training pay: Extra commissions on your first 8 deals Earn swag: Nike and Lululemon swag through performance incentives Incentive trips: To destinations like New Zealand, Iceland, Tahiti, Switzerland, and Cancun Quarterly stock incentives: Based on personal performance Responsibilities: Own your territory: Develop and manage sales in a residential area Connect with homeowners: Knock doors, network, and follow up on referrals Track your wins: Monitor sales activities and hit performance goals Close the deal: Present solar solutions to homeowners, explain financing, and guide customers through the process Educate & inspire: Help homeowners understand the benefits of going solar—cost savings, clean energy, and energy independence Grow with Sunrun: Attend weekly training meetings to sharpen skills, boost earnings, and unlock career growth opportunities Qualifications: Must be 18 years old Experience in direct or commission-based sales preferred Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends Comfortable working outdoors and walking for extended periods in various weather conditions If you're hungry for growth, passionate about clean energy, and ready to hustle, this is your moment. Join the Sunrun Street Team and turn your ambition into impact. Recruiter: Please note that the compensation information is made in good faith for this position only . It assumes that the successful candidate will be located in markets within the United States that warrant the compensation. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more. The starting salary/wage for this opportunity is in compliance with the local wage requirements. Compensation decisions will not be based on a candidate's salary history. You can learn more here . This job description outlines the primary responsibilities, some essential job functions, and qualifications for the role. It may not include all essential functions, tasks, or requirements. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and you need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process or to perform this role, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@sunrun.com . Sunrun is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. We believe that empowering people and valuing their differences are essential for our mission of connecting people to the cleanest energy on earth. Learn more here: EEO | Sunrun

rows.title: Solar Sales Consultant
rows.text: Since 2015, Venture Home has been shaking up the regional solar industry with a focus on sustainability, excellence and a vibrant company culture. We are one of only five companies statewide to earn the prestigious Platinum Designation Solar Installer Award from the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) Backed by a stellar 4.7 out of 5 rating from Forbes Home, we are recognized as an elite leader in our field, and we’re just getting started. About the Role A Solar Sales Consultant is NOT a lead generation role where you will be asked to knock on doors or cold call. We are seeking experienced sales representatives that are closers with a track record of success in sales and are looking for the right environment to be successful. A RELIABLE VEHICLE AND A LICENSE IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THE POSITION. Our appointment setting teams will schedule qualified appointments on your calendar for you to meet with the homeowner(s) and close with the best combination of products, services, and track record in the industry. We view the sales process in solar to be educational and we realize that it is an emotional decision for people to make the switch, so we focus on making sure that our customers understand not just how solar works, but also where the money is coming from to help pay for their project so that it doesn't seem "too good to be true". What you’ll bring: Sales experience - Required Outside sales (In-home sales) - preferred Solar experience – welcomed Willingness to learn Benefits: Base salary plus commission 401k match program Health, Dental, and Vision insurance Paid training Paid Time Off Referral program Opportunities for professional advancement Compensation: Base salary uncapped commission (OTE $100,000-$250,000) Powered by JazzHR

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Solar Superstar Sales Representative (1099) – Unlimited Earning Potential! Location: NJ/NY/PA – Remote/Field-Based | Compensation: Commission-Only ($150K for Top Performers) Green House Solar is growing – and we’re looking for superstar sales reps ready to build a high-income future in one of the most exciting and impactful industries out there. We’re a reputable, locally owned solar company with over 10 years in business and a track record of quality, customer care, and integrity. Our solar solutions are American-made, tariff-free, and designed to deliver real value to homeowners. Why Join Us? Proven earning potential – our top reps earn $150K annually Flexible commission or redline structures – choose what works for you You run your show – 1099 freedom with a team that’s got your back Some appointments provided – but we’re looking for those who can also hustle on their own Supportive, experienced leadership – we treat you like a business partner Who We’re Looking For: Self-motivated, high-energy closers Proven sales experience (solar or home improvement a big plus) Comfortable generating and working their own leads Clear communicator, professional, and coachable Excited to help customers save money and go green This is NOT for the faint of heart. We want go-getters who are hungry, ethical, and eager to grow with a company that values quality over hype . Interested in owning your schedule, helping people, and building wealth while doing work that matters? Let’s talk. Apply now or send your resume About Us: Green House Solar is located in the historical town of Madison, New Jersey and has been in business since 2015. We are a small, team-based business comprised of professionals that handle all aspects of the projects’ process in-house; from permitting through install and commissioning. We are focused on quality installations and excellent customer service. Making sure our installations will withstand the test of time and that our customers are greatly satisfied, is our top priority and a testament to our on-going success! As a small, family-oriented business, we are dedicated to bringing the best quality renewable energy to NJ. We want to make as big of an impact as possible for many years to come. We are not in solar because it’s the “next big thing.” We see renewable energy as a viable and necessary path to sustaining our planet for future generations and we are happy to be a part of it wherever it may lead us. Green House Solar follows EEO guidelines.

rows.title: Commercial Solar Sales
rows.text: Commercial Solar Sales Representative Solar Energy Solutions is seeking motivated and knowledgeable Commercial Solar Sales representatives to join our dedicated team. In this role, you will be responsible for promoting and selling our commercial solar energy solutions, helping businesses transition towards sustainable and cost-effective energy alternatives. As part of our team, you will engage with commercial clients to identify their energy needs, present tailored solar solutions, and guide them through the sales process. This position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the renewable energy sector while developing your professional skills in a fast-growing industry. This role will service OH, IL, and IN. Requirements Responsibilities: Identify and develop new commercial business opportunities within the solar energy market. Conduct consultations with clients to understand their energy consumption and provide customized solar solutions. Deliver compelling presentations and proposals that highlight the benefits and financial savings of solar installations. Work closely with the engineering and project management teams to ensure seamless project execution. Maintain relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business and referrals. Stay informed about industry trends, renewable energy policies, and available incentives. Qualifications: Proven sales experience, preferably within renewable energy or related technical fields. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and engaging manner. Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for sustainable energy. Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships. Familiarity with commercial solar products and industry standards is a plus. Willingness to stay updated on evolving market conditions and technologies. Join Solar Energy Solutions and play an integral role in shaping the future of clean energy! Benefits Competitive compensation plus commission ESOP Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance Paid time off. Paid Holidays Company 401K. Paid per diem for any time away from home.

rows.title: In Home Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Join the clean energy revolution! Solar Alternatives, the Louisiana's leading renewable energy company, is seeking an experienced sales consultant and one-call closer for remote, in-home and in-business sales for North Louisiana regional market. Target clients are nearby residential and commercial prospects in Mississippi. Excellent earning potential of $100k-$160k annually. As an Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Companies and winner of the 2018 and 2022 LifeCity Employee Wellness Award, Solar Alternatives' mission is to strengthen communities through comprehensive energy savings, backup power, and a low-carbon lifestyle. Over 4000 families and businesses have worked with our team to realize over $300 million in lifetime savings. If you are a professional who is passionate about helping clients, has successful experience with in-home sales, and can effectively cultivate a robust pipeline with integrity, excellent customer service, and ambitious sales targets, this opportunity is for you. This position is a result of new management plan to accelerate growth and focus on achieving regional market leadership. Thrive with confidence and pride in your work as you develop a strong portfolio of happy clients! Working alongside a skilled support staff with proprietary tools, complete training and ongoing learning opportunities will be provided. This position is primarily home office based, and will focus on local in-person appointments, and remote statewide appointments commercial and residential solar energy prospects. Please review qualifications before applying. RESPONSIBILITIES In-home, in-business and virtual sales of residential solar, energy savings and backup power solutions Additional commercial sales opportunities Generate custom proposals and organize documents necessary for presentation and closing Generate new leads from networking, database, event participation, and relationships Close deals and sign contracts with home and business owners Ability to efficiently plan schedule, set goals and work unsupervised Use company-provided screening procedures to qualify prospects Pursue individual and team sales targets Attend meetings, marketing events and training programs to stay informed of technology trends File sales reports and provide market feedback to team leader Strong potential for advancement Requirements Positive, energetic attitude, and ambitious with a strong desire to succeed Ability to speak with charisma and confidence Self-motivated and disciplined Proven and documented track record of sales success Proficiency in business software - Microsoft Office Suite, Drobbox, Slack Proficiency in standard internet tools and etiquette - email, cloud services, search Articulate and professional English writing and speech, bilingual a plus Willing and able to initiate marketing and self-generate a portion of prospects Reliable transportation, valid license, clean driving record Willing to work occasional weekends as needed for marketing events Experience with CRM, Salesforce.com preferred Home improvement, auto sales or in-home sales experience preferred Benefits Advanced product and sales training to ensure success Unlimited earning potential, with average commission of $2,500 per sale Top performers earn $150k per year 100% Commission and Bonuses for Self-Gen & Referral Sales available Two weeks time off, plus 7 bank holidays Use of proprietary company tools including industry leading quotation and formatted selling systems Qualified leads from the best sources available The peace of mind that comes with offering only best in class products, installation, and services Gas card & vehicle allowance Health insurance, vision, dental Simple-IRA with company match

rows.title: Solar Sales Consultant
rows.text: Since 2015, Venture Home has been shaking up the regional solar industry with a focus on sustainability, excellence and a vibrant company culture. We are one of only five companies statewide to earn the prestigious Platinum Designation Solar Installer Award from the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA) Backed by a stellar 4.7 out of 5 rating from Forbes Home, we are recognized as an elite leader in our field, and we’re just getting started. About the Role We are seeking experienced, driven Solar Sales Consultants who excel at building relationships and closing deals. If you are a proven sales professional looking for a high-performance environment with a strong support system, this is the right place for you. Our appointment setting teams will schedule qualified appointments on your calendar for you to meet with the homeowner(s) and close with the best combination of products, services, and track record in the industry. We view the sales process in solar to be educational and we realize that it is an emotional decision for people to make the switch, so we focus on making sure that our customers understand not just how solar works, but also where the money is coming from to help pay for their project so that it doesn't seem "too good to be true". A RELIABLE VEHICLE AND A LICENSE IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THE POSITION. What you’ll bring: Sales experience - Required Outside sales (In-home sales) - preferred Solar experience – welcomed Willingness to learn Benefits: Base salary plus commission 401k match program Health, Dental, and Vision insurance Paid training Paid Time Off Referral program Opportunities for professional advancement Compensation: Base salary uncapped commission (OTE $100,000-$250,000) Powered by JazzHR

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Position Overview: This position will be based out of either our Westminster or Centennial, CO location. We are seeking a motivated and experienced Solar Sales Representative to join our team, focused on identifying and converting new residential solar opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a strong sales background, solid product knowledge, and the ability to guide clients through the entire process from first contact to signed contract. Job Responsibilities: Client Acquisition : Identify and prospect new clients through various channels, including cold calling, networking, referrals, and online lead generation. Consultative Selling : Understand the unique energy needs and requirements of each client, and tailor solar PV solutions to meet their specific goals and budget. Sales Presentations : Create compelling presentations and proposals to effectively communicate the benefits of solar PV systems to potential clients. Quoting and Pricing : Provide accurate and competitive quotes based on client needs, system specifications, and financial analysis. Execute change orders and update systems accordingly. Relationship Building : Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing exceptional customer service and addressing their concerns and questions. Product Knowledge : Stay up-to-date with the latest solar PV technology and industry trends to effectively educate clients and offer innovative solutions. Market Research : Continuously research and analyze the solar PV market, competitors, and industry developments to identify opportunities and stay competitive. Sales Targets : Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets and KPIs set by the company. Documentation : Maintain accurate and organized records of all sales activities, including client interactions, contracts, change orders, and project details. Collaboration : Collaborate with our technical and installation teams, project management, and finance to ensure a smooth transition from sale to project implementation, to final sign-off of the project. Requirements Experience : Proven track record in sales, with a minimum of 3 years of experience. Solar industry experience highly preferred. Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of solar PV technology, renewable energy concepts, and knowledge of rebates and incentives. Customer Service : Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients. Self-Direction : Self-motivated and target-driven, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Technical Tools : Proficiency in using CRM software (Hubspot) and the Google stack. Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred but not mandatory. Pay for this position is an hourly base plus uncapped commission. OTE for fully ramped representatives typically ranges between $120k-$200k per year, depending on performance. Photon Brothers offers a full benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid holidays, company-sponsored life insurance, telehealth, and a 401k plan with company match. This role will be posted until September 30, 2026 at a minimum, or until the role is filled.

rows.text: Solar Sales Representative Commission-Only • Uncapped Earning Potential Brooklyn SolarWorks | New York City (Five Boroughs) | Full-Time, W-2 About Brooklyn SolarWorks Brooklyn SolarWorks is a mission-driven residential solar company making rooftop solar accessible across New York City. We design and install custom solar solutions for NYC homeowners, and we’re growing fast. Our sales team is the engine behind that growth. The Opportunity This is a true sales role for a true salesperson. Your commission is uncapped — there is no ceiling on what you can earn. Every deal you close adds directly to your income, and the best consultants on our team are rewarded accordingly. If you’re motivated by performance, energized by closing, and want your effort to translate into unlimited earning potential, this is the seat for you. We sell a product people genuinely want, in a market that’s only expanding. You bring the drive; we provide the lead support, training, product, and a back office that lets you focus on selling. What You’ll Do Meet with NYC homeowners to assess their solar needs and present customized solutions Manage your pipeline from first conversation through signed contract Generate and develop your own leads while working company-provided opportunities Guide homeowners through pricing, financing, and the path to installation Represent Brooklyn SolarWorks professionally in the field and in the community What We’re Looking For A proven closer who thrives in a commission-driven environment Strong communication and relationship-building skills Self-motivated and disciplined with your time and pipeline Comfortable working in the field across the five boroughs Prior in-home, outside, or solar/home-improvement sales experience is a plus, but we’ll consider the right driven candidate Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record is required Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Exact Solar - Top 500 Solar Installer in North America 2014 - 2021; Earned Angies List Super Service Award 8 years in a row (2013-2020); Inc. 5000 company 2017 and 2018; Philadelphia Civic 50 Winner 2022; Best of Philly 2021 and Best of Bucks 2021 Winning Solar Installer. rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.location: Santa Fe Springs, Los Angeles County
rows.text: At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the 1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with. Who We Are We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Join the Sunrun Street Team – Where Hustle Meets High Earnings Looking for a role where your drive, grit, and ambition translate directly into income? Whether you're a seasoned closer or new to sales and ready to learn, Sunrun gives you the tools, training, and opportunity to succeed. With uncapped commission, flexible schedules, and world-class support, our Sales Specialists are helping homeowners save money and switch to clean energy, while building incredible careers. 2024 Highlights 50% of our first year Sales Specialists earned $100,000 Top 10% average earnings for new hires was $205,020 Top 100 earners regardless of hire date or current status earned $388,000 Direct seller, commission only role, best suited for highly motivated individuals who thrive on performance-based rewards. How You Will Be Rewarded: Unlimited earnings potential: Top 10% of Sales Specialists earn $300,000 Flexible schedule: Enjoy autonomy of a flexible schedule after the training period World-class training: Learn from the best sales specialists in the industry Career growth: Clear paths for advancement Bonus training pay: Extra commissions on your first 8 deals Earn swag: Nike and Lululemon swag through performance incentives Incentive trips: To destinations like New Zealand, Iceland, Tahiti, Switzerland, and Cancun Quarterly stock incentives: Based on personal performance Responsibilities: Own your territory: Develop and manage sales in a residential area Connect with homeowners: Knock doors, network, and follow up on referrals Track your wins: Monitor sales activities and hit performance goals Close the deal: Present solar solutions to homeowners, explain financing, and guide customers through the process Educate & inspire: Help homeowners understand the benefits of going solar—cost savings, clean energy, and energy independence Grow with Sunrun: Attend weekly training meetings to sharpen skills, boost earnings, and unlock career growth opportunities Qualifications: Must be 18 years old Experience in direct or commission-based sales preferred Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends Comfortable working outdoors and walking for extended periods in various weather conditions If you're hungry for growth, passionate about clean energy, and ready to hustle, this is your moment. Join the Sunrun Street Team and turn your ambition into impact. Applicants must hold a valid California Home Improvement Salesperson (HIS) License. If a candidate is selected but does not yet possess this license, they will be hired initially as a Sales Scheduler (paid at minimum wage and capped at 35 hours/week). Upon successfully obtaining the HIS license, the employee will transition into the Solar Sales Direct Seller role, which is 100% commission-based. While the average compensation ranges from $60,000 to $100,000 (location and personal success dependent), our top performers can earn up to an impressive $205,020 per year. Average compensation in California for the first 12 months ranges from $60,000 to $90,000 (personal success dependent). Recruiter: Danielle Youmans (danielle.youmans@sunrun.com) Please note that the compensation information is made in good faith for this position only . It assumes that the successful candidate will be located in markets within the United States that warrant the compensation. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more. The starting salary/wage for this opportunity is in compliance with the local wage requirements. Compensation decisions will not be based on a candidate's salary history. You can learn more here . This job description outlines the primary responsibilities, some essential job functions, and qualifications for the role. It may not include all essential functions, tasks, or requirements. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and you need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process or to perform this role, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@sunrun.com . Sunrun is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. We believe that empowering people and valuing their differences are essential for our mission of connecting people to the cleanest energy on earth. Learn more here: EEO | Sunrun

rows.title: Experienced Solar Sales Closer - Uncapped Commission - $150k Yearly
rows.text: Solar Sales Representative 1 Earth Solar | Illinois | Full-Time | 1099 Independent Contractor | Uncapped Commission Earn $150,000 - $300,000 Per Year Join One of Illinois' Fastest Growing Solar Companies Are you an experienced solar sales professional ready to maximize your earning potential and take full control of your sales career? At 1 Earth Solar, we're looking for proven Solar Sales Closers who thrive in a high-performance environment and want the freedom to sell without unnecessary corporate restrictions. If you're passionate about helping homeowners save money, value ethical selling, and are ready to earn six figures or more, this opportunity is for you. Unlike many solar companies, we handle everything in-house—from design and engineering to installation and roofing—allowing our sales professionals to deliver an exceptional customer experience and close deals with confidence. Why Homeowners Choose 1 Earth Solar A Better Business Bureau rating. 4.8–4.9-star customer reviews across Illinois. Faster installation timelines with local operations. In-house roofing, electrical, design, and installation teams. Ethical, customer-first sales approach. Strong local reputation that helps build homeowner trust. Why Join 1 Earth Solar? This opportunity is designed for experienced solar professionals who want the flexibility of an independent sales model while earning industry-leading commissions. What Makes Us Different Freedom to Sell Your Way No micromanagement. No corporate layers or unnecessary oversight. Flexible schedule and independent work environment. Operate like a business partner—not just another sales representative. Local Market Advantage Illinois-focused company with deep market expertise. Active installation branches in Joliet and Peoria. Faster project completion and happier customers. In-House Operations Roofing services available in-house. Electrical upgrades handled internally. CAD design completed by our team. Higher close rates and fewer installation delays. What You'll Do Conduct Solar Consultations Meet with homeowners through in-home or virtual appointments. Analyze energy usage and identify opportunities for solar savings. Present customized solar solutions with clear financial benefits and return on investment. Manage the Full Sales Cycle Educate homeowners on solar ownership and financing options. Guide customers through available financing programs, including loans, PPAs, and TPO options. Handle objections professionally and ethically. Close deals confidently while providing an outstanding customer experience. Own Your Pipeline Manage your leads and sales opportunities from consultation through installation. Self-generate business opportunities (preferred). Track and manage your sales pipeline effectively. Build long-term customer relationships and referral opportunities. Compensation & Earning Potential This is a 100% commission-based, 1099 independent contractor position. Expected Earnings $150,000 - $300,000 annually for experienced solar closers. Uncapped commission structure. High-ticket solar sales with significant per-sale earnings. Unlimited income potential based on performance. Your success directly determines your earning potential. Qualifications Required Minimum of 2 years of solar sales experience. At least 1 year of solar closing experience. Proven ability to independently close solar sales. Strong understanding of solar financing options, including: TPO (Third-Party Ownership) Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) Solar loans Self-motivated and disciplined work ethic. Ethical and consultative sales approach. Preferred Illinois-based candidates. Experience conducting in-home sales presentations. Ability to self-generate leads and referrals. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Who Thrives in This Role? Our top performers are professionals who: Are experienced solar closers ready for their next opportunity. Want the freedom to run their business their way. Enjoy building relationships and educating homeowners. Thrive in performance-based environments. Are financially motivated and goal-oriented. Value integrity and long-term customer success. Take ownership of their results and earning potential. This Role Is NOT For This opportunity is not a fit for: Entry-level sales representatives. Appointment setters looking to transition into closing. Candidates without solar closing experience. Individuals who require daily supervision or extensive sales training. Professionals seeking hourly or salaried compensation. About 1 Earth Solar 1 Earth Solar is a locally rooted, full-service solar company proudly serving homeowners across Illinois. We believe in transparency, professionalism, and delivering exceptional customer experiences through our fully in-house operations. Our mission is simple: provide homeowners with high-quality solar solutions while creating extraordinary career opportunities for our sales professionals. Apply Today! If you're an experienced Solar Sales Closer looking for a high-income opportunity with the freedom to sell independently and the support of a trusted local installer, we'd love to hear from you. Join 1 Earth Solar and build a six-figure career while helping homeowners power their future with solar energy.

rows.text: Retail Sales Representative Join Venture Home and Help Homeowners Save with Clean Energy! At Venture Home, we believe clean energy should be accessible and affordable. As one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing residential energy companies, we help homeowners take control of their utility bills through solar, battery storage, and modern electrical upgrades. If you’re passionate about sustainability, love connecting with people, and want to make a tangible difference in your community, we want you to be part of the team! About the Role You will have the opportunity to be located within a large home improvement store chain. We're looking for outgoing, motivated individuals to join our sales team as Retail Sales Representative . In this customer-facing role, you'll represent Venture Home inside designated retail locations, educating homeowners about the benefits of solar energy and scheduling complimentary in-home consultations with our Energy Consultants. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys meeting new people, thrives in a retail environment, and wants to build a rewarding career with a rapidly growing company. What You'll Do Represent Venture Home professionally inside assigned Lowe's retail locations. Engage homeowners in friendly, informative conversations about solar energy and home energy savings. Qualify homeowners based on basic solar eligibility criteria. Educate customers on the financial and environmental benefits of going solar. Schedule qualified homeowners for complimentary in-home consultations with a Venture Home Energy Consultant. Accurately document customer information and appointments. Attend ongoing training sessions to stay current on products, promotions, and industry knowledge. Consistently achieve appointment and performance goals while delivering an outstanding customer experience. Compensation & Benefits On-Target Earnings (OTE): $55,000–$85,000 annual potential Competitive hourly pay uncapped commission MUST BE ABLE TO WORK FROM 3 PM - 9 PM EST. If Full Time, full benefits package for eligible employees, including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance Paid time off Paid training 401(k) retirement plan with company match Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization Qualifications Friendly, confident, and comfortable starting conversations with new people. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Professional appearance and positive attitude. Strong work ethic and a customer-first mindset. Reliable transportation to assigned Lowe's locations. Dependable and responsive via phone, text, and email. Willingness to learn and continuously improve. Previous experience in retail sales, customer service, lead generation, marketing, or hospitality is preferred but not required. Why Venture Home? At Venture Home, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive training, supportive leadership, and clear career paths have helped many team members grow into high-performing sales professionals and leadership positions. If you're looking for a company that rewards hard work, values personal growth, and provides unlimited earning potential, we'd love to meet you. Powered by JazzHR

rows.text: At Sunrun, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Solar Sales Representative Build Your Income, Own Your Success with ATX Solar! Are you a driven sales professional who thrives on competition, building relationships, and creating your own success? ATX Solar is looking for motivated and ambitious Solar Sales Representatives to join our growing team. This is a 1099, performance-based, commission-only opportunity designed for self-starters with a true hunter mentality. If you are passionate about sales, enjoy connecting with homeowners, and have the discipline to manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing, this is an opportunity where your effort directly impacts your earnings. About the Role As a Solar Sales Representative , you will be responsible for generating your own opportunities, educating homeowners on the benefits of solar energy, and guiding customers through the complete sales process. You will take ownership of the customer experience—from initial outreach and consultation to presenting solutions and closing the deal. Proven performers who consistently generate results will have access to supplemental leads to help accelerate their growth. What You'll Do Generate Your Own Leads: Prospect and create new opportunities through networking, referrals, door-to-door outreach, and other sales strategies. Consult with Homeowners: Meet with potential customers to understand their energy needs and educate them on solar solutions. Present Solar Solutions: Explain the benefits, savings potential, and value of ATX Solar's products and services. Manage the Full Sales Cycle: Handle every stage of the sales process, from initial contact through contract completion. Build Customer Relationships: Establish trust and provide an exceptional customer experience. Follow Up Consistently: Stay connected with prospects and customers to move opportunities forward. Achieve Sales Goals: Work toward individual milestones and maximize your earning potential. Compensation & Growth Opportunity This is a 1099 commission-only sales position with uncapped earning potential. Your income is directly tied to your effort, performance, and ability to close deals. Successful representatives who demonstrate consistent sales production and reach self-generated sales milestones may receive access to supplemental company-provided leads to support continued growth. What We're Looking For A hunter mentality with the drive to create opportunities and close sales. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Self-motivation and the ability to work independently. Confidence speaking with homeowners and presenting solutions. A competitive mindset with a desire to exceed goals. Ability to manage the entire sales process from prospecting to close. Preferred Experience Ideal candidates may have experience in: Door-to-door solar sales Roofing sales Home improvement sales Outside sales High-ticket commission-based sales Previous experience is preferred but not required. We are looking for individuals who are coachable, motivated, and ready to build a successful sales career. About ATX Solar At ATX Solar , we believe in helping homeowners make smart energy decisions while providing sales professionals with the opportunity to build a rewarding career. We are looking for driven individuals who are ready to take ownership of their success and grow with our team. If you have the ambition, work ethic, and sales mindset to succeed, we want to hear from you!

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Solar Sales Representative This position will be based out of either our Westminster or Centennial, CO location. We are seeking a motivated and experienced Solar Sales Representative to join our team, focused on identifying and converting new residential solar opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a strong sales background, solid product knowledge, and the ability to guide clients through the entire process from first contact to signed contract. Job Responsibilities Client Acquisition: Identify and prospect new clients through various channels, including cold calling, networking, referrals, and online lead generation. Consultative Selling: Understand the unique energy needs and requirements of each client, and tailor solar PV solutions to meet their specific goals and budget. Sales Presentations: Create compelling presentations and proposals to effectively communicate the benefits of solar PV systems to potential clients. Quoting and Pricing: Provide accurate and competitive quotes based on client needs, system specifications, and financial analysis. Execute change orders and update systems accordingly. Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing exceptional customer service and addressing their concerns and questions. Product Knowledge: Stay up-to-date with the latest solar PV technology and industry trends to effectively educate clients and offer innovative solutions. Market Research: Continuously research and analyze the solar PV market, competitors, and industry developments to identify opportunities and stay competitive. Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets and KPIs set by the company. Documentation: Maintain accurate and organized records of all sales activities, including client interactions, contracts, change orders, and project details. Collaboration: Collaborate with our technical and installation teams, project management, and finance to ensure a smooth transition from sale to project implementation, to final sign-off of the project. Requirements Experience: Proven track record in sales, with a minimum of 3 years of experience. Solar industry experience highly preferred. Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of solar PV technology, renewable energy concepts, and knowledge of rebates and incentives. Customer Service: Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients. Self-Direction: Self-motivated and target-driven, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Technical Tools: Proficiency in using CRM software (Hubspot) and the Google stack. Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred but not mandatory. Pay for this position is an hourly base plus uncapped commission. OTE for fully ramped representatives typically ranges between $120k-$200k per year, depending on performance. Photon Brothers offers a full benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid holidays, company-sponsored life insurance, telehealth, and a 401k plan with company match. At Photon Brothers, we're dedicated to leading the way in clean energy solutions and helping our clients transition to sustainable, reliable power sources. As a trusted provider of electrical services, we specialize in the installation of solar panels, battery storage systems, and EV chargers, and are proud partners in Tesla's Powerwall Certified Installer program. We also offer roofing services, detach and reset, and solar system maintenance, making us a full-service home energy company. With locations across Colorado and California, we keep everything in-house — from sales and project management to installation and service — so our customers always know who to call.

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Solar Sales Representative We save the environment while saving people money! Solar Sales Representative Job Description We are looking for a passionate solar sales representative to join our growing solar installation company. As a solar sales representative, you will have the first contact with our customers, providing them with information about our products and the benefits of going solar. Your duties will include analyzing the needs of the customer, calculating resources, preparing quotes, demonstrating our products, and providing after-sales support. You may also be required to visit customer sites and consult on larger installations. To ensure success as a solar sales representative, you should have excellent interpersonal skills, a passion for solar energy, and a solid background in sales. Ultimately, a top-class Solar Sales Representative builds a rapport with customers and provides them with tailor-made solar solutions. Solar Sales Representative Responsibilities Meeting with customers in their homes and/or businesses. Providing customers with information about company equipment and solar systems Demonstrating company solar products in a working environment Gathering information to accurately identify the customer's solar needs Selecting solar energy products and systems to best suit the customer's needs Preparing or reviewing designs for the customer's solar installation Creating fully customized energy packagers for large-scale solar installations Providing customers with quotes, sales orders, shipping information, and tax credit information Providing after-sales service including courtesy calls and site visits Completing sales order paperwork Generating potential leads for new accounts Solar Sales Representative Requirements Professional appearance and a friendly disposition Patience; self-motivated and outgoing Ability to relate technical information in layman's terms Ability to work irregular hours

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: We Will Train You to be an Expert in Solar Sales First year average compensation: $82000 – $112000 / Year Who is solarXperts? We are on a mission to Change the World One Home at a Time by Making Solar Simple and Affordable . Due to this philosophy, and decades of combined Home Improvement experience, thousands of families have trusted our Xperts! Your career starts here: solarXperts is offering the opportunity for the right person to train as a Sales Representative in the quickly growing industry of solar sales, no experience necessary. We are seeking highly motivated workers who have the drive to learn their role as a Sales Rep inside and out, and help homeowners save money, and the environment, by converting their homes to solar energy. Your Duties: Secure Solar System deals with homeowners through in-home presentations Complete all necessary paperwork and financing documents to close the sale Generate new leads through canvassing, referrals, and other means of lead generation Continue to Learn and Advance both your Solar Industry knowledge and Sales Skills We Offer: Indus try-leading Sales Rep Training and Solar Education – We will teach you everything you need to know to become successful in solar sales, including sizing, demoing, closing, and generating deals. High Commission Split – We retain the best sales reps in the business by offering one of the most generous commission structures in the industry – up to 80% for qualifying representatives. Top Sales Reps generate 15 or more Sales per Month. Fast Start Program – Earn up to $1,500 bonus for each sale during your First 30 days . We understand it can take time to build your pipeline in a sales representative position, our Fast Start program aims to let our reps earn while they are learning on the job. Leadership Development – As a rapidly growing company, we develop our sales representatives into leaders so we can promote from within. We Are Looking For: Smart, personable, and driven people to learn and execute our proven selling system People dedicated to improving their craft as a sales rep, their lives, and their communities Competitors who work well both with a team and individually Desire to learn about the alternative energy sales industry Qualifications: Full Time Availability Strong Communication and Critical Thinking skills High School Diploma (some college preferred) Valid Driver's License and Reliable Transportation Sales Reps' First year average compensation: $82000 – $112000 / Year

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative - Home Solutions
rows.text: ​ Join Venture Home and Help Homeowners Save with Clean Energy! At Venture Home, we believe clean energy should be accessible and affordable. As one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing residential energy companies, we help homeowners take control of their utility bills through solar, battery storage, and modern electrical upgrades. If you’re passionate about sustainability, love connecting with people, and want to make a tangible difference in your community, we want you to be part of the team! About the Role A Solar Sales Consultant is NOT a lead generation role where you will be asked to knock on doors or cold call. We are seeking experienced sales representatives that are closers with a track record of success in sales and are looking for the right environment to be successful . Our appointment setting teams will schedule qualified appointments on your calendar for you to meet with the homeowners and close with the best combination of products, services, and track record in the industry. We view the sales process in solar to be educational and we realize that it is an emotional decision for people to make the switch, so we focus on making sure that our customers understand not just how solar works, but also where the money is coming from to help pay for their project so that it doesn't seem "too good to be true". What you’ll bring: Sales experience - Required Outside sales (In-home sales) - preferred Solar experience – welcomed Willingness to learn Benefits: Base salary plus commission 401k match program Health, Dental, and Vision insurance Paid Time Off Compensation: Base salary uncapped commission (OTE $100,000-$250,000)

rows.title: Commercial Solar Sales
rows.text: Commercial Solar Sales Representative Solar Energy Solutions is seeking motivated and knowledgeable Commercial Solar Sales representatives to join our dedicated team. In this role, you will be responsible for promoting and selling our commercial solar energy solutions, helping businesses transition towards sustainable and cost-effective energy alternatives. As part of our team, you will engage with commercial clients to identify their energy needs, present tailored solar solutions, and guide them through the sales process. This position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the renewable energy sector while developing your professional skills in a fast-growing industry. This role will service OH, IL, and IN. Requirements Responsibilities: Identify and develop new commercial business opportunities within the solar energy market. Conduct consultations with clients to understand their energy consumption and provide customized solar solutions. Deliver compelling presentations and proposals that highlight the benefits and financial savings of solar installations. Work closely with the engineering and project management teams to ensure seamless project execution. Maintain relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business and referrals. Stay informed about industry trends, renewable energy policies, and available incentives. Qualifications: Proven sales experience, preferably within renewable energy or related technical fields. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and engaging manner. Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for sustainable energy. Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships. Familiarity with commercial solar products and industry standards is a plus. Willingness to stay updated on evolving market conditions and technologies. Join Solar Energy Solutions and play an integral role in shaping the future of clean energy! Benefits Competitive compensation plus commission ESOP Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance Paid time off. Paid Holidays Company 401K. Paid per diem for any time away from home.

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.text: Solar Sales Representative Full-Time | Field Sales | Commission-Based | Independent Sales Opportunity Build Your Career in Solar Sales Are you an experienced sales professional who enjoys meeting customers, building relationships, and taking ownership of the sales process? Central Plains Electric is looking for motivated Dealer Owners to help homeowners explore solar energy solutions. This is a field-based, full-cycle sales opportunity where you'll work directly with customers, understand their energy needs, present solutions, and guide them through the decision-making process. If you're self-motivated, comfortable working independently, and enjoy a performance-driven environment, this could be an opportunity to build a rewarding career in renewable energy. About the Role As a Dealer Owner, you'll manage your sales activities from prospecting through closing. You'll connect with homeowners, learn about their energy goals, explain available solar solutions, and help qualified customers determine whether solar is a good fit for their home. You'll have the independence to organize your schedule, manage your pipeline, and develop customer relationships within your territory. What You'll Do Connect with homeowners through in-person outreach and prospecting. Introduce Central Plains Electric and explain available solar solutions. Build rapport and establish professional relationships with prospective customers. Ask questions to understand customers' energy needs and priorities. Conduct needs assessments and identify appropriate solutions. Present solar options and explain their features and benefits. Answer questions and address customer concerns. Follow up consistently with prospective customers. Manage your sales pipeline from initial contact through closing. Prepare and present proposals to qualified customers. Guide customers through the purchasing process and secure agreements. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activity. Manage your daily schedule and territory independently. What We're Looking For We're looking for motivated sales professionals who are comfortable taking ownership of their results. Successful candidates typically have: Previous sales experience; solar or energy sales experience is a plus. Experience managing a sales process from prospecting through closing. Strong face-to-face communication and presentation skills. Ability to build trust and establish rapport quickly. Strong listening and needs-assessment skills. Confidence handling customer questions and objections. Self-motivation and strong time-management skills. A professional and customer-focused approach. Resilience and a willingness to learn. Ability to work independently while following established processes. Requirements Reliable transportation for travel to customer appointments. Authorized to work in the United States. Ability to work in a field-based, customer-facing environment. Willingness to conduct in-person prospecting and customer consultations. Compensation This is a commission-only opportunity with compensation based on individual sales performance. Successful Dealer Owners may earn approximately $100,000–$165,000 annually , depending on sales activity, individual performance, and results. Actual earnings vary based on individual sales performance. Why Join Central Plains Electric? Build experience in the growing renewable energy industry. Manage the complete sales process from prospecting to closing. Work directly with homeowners and help them explore energy solutions. Enjoy the independence of managing your own sales activities. Develop valuable sales, communication, and customer relationship skills. Performance-based earning opportunity. Opportunity to build a long-term career in solar sales. About Central Plains Electric Central Plains Electric is committed to helping customers explore sustainable and cost-effective energy solutions. Our team works with homeowners to understand their energy needs and identify solutions that may be a good fit for their homes. We're looking for motivated sales professionals who want to develop their skills, work directly with customers, and grow within the renewable energy industry. Ready to Get Started? If you're motivated, customer-focused, and ready to take ownership of the full sales process, apply today to become a Dealer Owner with Central Plains Electric.

rows.title: Solar Sales Representative
rows.location: San Luis Obispo, San Luis Obispo County
rows.text: About Us At Photon Brothers, we're dedicated to leading the way in clean energy solutions and helping our clients transition to sustainable, reliable power sources. As a trusted provider of electrical services, we specialize in the installation of solar panels, battery storage systems, and EV chargers, and are proud partners in Tesla's Powerwall Certified Installer program. We also offer roofing services, detach and reset, and solar system maintenance, making us a full-service home energy company. With locations across Colorado and California, we keep everything in-house — from sales and project management to installation and service — so our customers always know who to call. Position Overview: This position will be based out of our San Luis Obispo, CA location. We are seeking a motivated and experienced Solar Sales Representative to join our team, focused on identifying and converting new residential solar opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a strong sales background, solid product knowledge, and the ability to guide clients through the entire process from first contact to signed contract. Job Responsibilities: Client Acquisition : Identify and prospect new clients through various channels, including cold calling, networking, referrals, and online lead generation. Consultative Selling : Understand the unique energy needs and requirements of each client, and tailor solar PV solutions to meet their specific goals and budget. Sales Presentations : Create compelling presentations and proposals to effectively communicate the benefits of solar PV systems to potential clients. Quoting and Pricing : Provide accurate and competitive quotes based on client needs, system specifications, and financial analysis. Execute change orders and update systems accordingly. Relationship Building : Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing exceptional customer service and addressing their concerns and questions. Product Knowledge : Stay up-to-date with the latest solar PV technology and industry trends to effectively educate clients and offer innovative solutions. Market Research : Continuously research and analyze the solar PV market, competitors, and industry developments to identify opportunities and stay competitive. Sales Targets : Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets and KPIs set by the company. Documentation : Maintain accurate and organized records of all sales activities, including client interactions, contracts, change orders, and project details. Collaboration : Collaborate with our technical and installation teams, project management, and finance to ensure a smooth transition from sale to project implementation, to final sign-off of the project. Requirements Experience : Proven track record in sales, with a minimum of 3 years of experience. Solar industry experience highly preferred. Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of solar PV technology, renewable energy concepts, and knowledge of rebates and incentives. Customer Service : Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients. Self-Direction : Self-motivated and target-driven, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Technical Tools : Proficiency in using CRM software (Hubspot) and the Google stack. REQUIRED: Current HIS License or able to obtain HIS License within 4 weeks of start date. Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred but not mandatory. Pay for this position is an hourly base plus uncapped commission. OTE for fully ramped representatives typically ranges between $120k-$200k per year, depending on performance. Photon Brothers offers a full benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid holidays, company-sponsored life insurance, telehealth, and a 401k plan with company match. This role will be posted until September 30, 2026 at a minimum, or until the role is filled. The pay range for this role is: 80,000 - 200,000 USD per year(San Luis Obispo) PI4cfdf543fac9-26172-39826928

Follow-Up: Maintain regular follow-up with potential customers to answer questions, provide additional information and facilitate the decision-making process. Customer Service: Provide exceptional customer service throughout the sales process and post-installation to ensure customer satisfaction and encourage referrals. rows.title: In-Home Solar Sales Consultant
rows.text: Energy Consultant — Close Deals. Change Lives. Houston, TX Full-Time On-Site Commission-Based Hungry. Passionate. Driven by results. If that's you, we've got a seat on our sales team with your name on it — and no cap on what you can earn. Freedom Power was born when Freedom Solar and Freedom HVAC joined forces to become Texas's complete whole-house energy company. We don't just install equipment. We hand homeowners the keys to something bigger: control over their energy, their bills, and their future. We call it Energy Empowerment, and it's not a tagline — it's the reason we show up every day. As an Energy Consultant, you'll sit down with homeowners and show them exactly what solar can do for their home and their wallet. You'll receive pre-qualified leads, design solar systems that actually fit, and close deals — all backed by two weeks of company-paid sales training to get you field-ready from day one. Hit your numbers, and $150K+ a year isn't a stretch goal. It's the floor for consultants who show up and have the skills. In this role you will also be eligible to sell our other product lines, such as generators, batteries, and hvac, if you prove yourself as a top performer. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY Consult with prospective customers on solar energy solutions for their home. Hit your numbers — quotas, lead response time, meeting conversions, all of it. Qualify prospective customers using proven and creative lead methods to build your own book of business. Design and build solar energy systems tailored to each customer's needs. Dive into ongoing training — classroom instruction, self-study, licensing, and lead-qualifying activities. Build real relationships with your sphere of influence and the community. Work hand-in-hand with our affiliate partners and vendors for flawless lead response and nurturing. Keep your weekly reporting sharp and on time. Show up at community events and outreach opportunities to meet future customers. WHAT YOU BRING A results-driven mindset — you're motivated by hitting (and beating) your numbers Hunger and passion for the work, not just a paycheck The ability to close deals — 3+ years of solar or in-home sales experience is a big plus A genuine desire to help people, with an eye for the details that matter Quick thinking and clear communication, especially on your feet A problem-solver's mindset — you love a challenge and love finding the fix THE PHYSICAL SIDE Comfortable with light lifting and carrying (under 15 lbs), walking, standing, and sitting throughout the day Able to operate office equipment and a motor vehicle, with travel by car roughly 10% of the time Comfortable working closely with others as well as independently WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Uncapped commission — your effort and results decide your paycheck, not a ceiling Average earnings of $150,000+ per year for consultants meeting KPI expectations Two weeks of company-paid sales training to set you up for success in the field A steady pipeline of leads and support from our affiliate partners and vendors Uncapped earning potential – your effort and results decide your paycheck, not a ceiling ONE MORE THING One of our favorite core values is Give a Damn — and that's exactly what we're looking for. Don't check every box above? Apply anyway. We hire for grit, hustle, and character as much as resumes — and we're always excited to discover skills we didn't know we needed. Freedom Power is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Freedom Solar is looking to add to our growing sales team with an In-Home Solar Design Consultant. We want hungry, passionate, and results-driven Sales Consultants to join us! You will educate, qualify, and advise future customers on the benefits of smart energy conservation and consumption practices. This is a commission-based opportunity.

rows.text: Join Venture Home and Help Homeowners Save with Clean Energy!At Venture Home, we believe clean energy should be accessible and affordable. As one of the Northeast’s fastest-growing residential energy companies, we help homeowners take control of their utility bills through solar, battery storage, and modern electrical upgrades.If you’re passionate about sustainability, love connecting with people, and want to make a tangible difference in your community, we want you to be part of the team!About the RoleWe are seeking experienced, driven Solar Sales Consultants who excel at building relationships and closing deals.
